prompt: Write a police officer's crash report narrative (about 120 words). Collision type: rear-end collision in Sugar Land, Texas. The claimant was a driver and reported wrist fracture. Refer to people as Driver 1, Driver 2 or Passenger. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1279; do not mention it.)
text: Officer narrative. On arrival at the scene in Sugar Land, Texas, I observed two vehicles in the right lane of the eastbound roadway with rear-end damage to the second vehicle. Driver 2 stated that the vehicle ahead slowed abruptly in heavy traffic and that Driver 2 was unable to stop in time, resulting in contact with the rear bumper of Driver 1's vehicle. Driver 1 stated that they had come to a complete stop before being struck. A passenger in Driver 1's vehicle was present and was not in the front seat at the time of impact. Driver 1 reported pain in the left wrist and was assisted by emergency medical services, who transported Driver 1 for evaluation. Both drivers were able to provide valid insurance information. Weather was clear and the road surface was dry. No citations were issued at the scene pending further investigation. Photographs were taken of both vehicles and the point of impact.
